intro.text: Small Silver Ingot, Small Gold Ingot and Small Platinum Ingot are used in variety of tradeskill processes.

items.comment: or any other ring or bracer

steps.text: Note: The initial process involves x3.2 in Mechanical Engineering Skill when dealing with Gold, x2.75 in Mechanical Engineering Skill when dealing with Silver both based on the QL of the material
Note: #L "Small Platinum Ingot" "151363" can only be found from Mobs, Dyna & Mission bosses and as chestloot. Silver and Gold ingots can also be tradeskilled from:

- #L "Small Gold Ingot" "151369": #L "Golden Sphere" "136643" - #L "Golden Ring" "136599" - #L "Marriage Ring" "136607" - #L "Bracer of Shielding - Projectile" "84163" - #L "Bracelet of Ka" "136619" - #L "Golden Bracer" "136621" - #L "Golden Nugget" "136631" - #L "Pink Ring" "136615" - #L "Bracer of Shielding - Physics" "84165" - #L "Bracer of Shielding - Nano" "84167" - #L "Bracer of Shielding - Melee" "84169" - #L "Bracer of Shielding - Energy" "84171" - #L "Bracer of Shielding - Elements" "84173"

- #L "Small Silver Ingot" "150912": #L "Flower Ring" "136605" - #L "OT Ring" "136609" - #L "Silver Nugget" "136635" - #L "Ring of Luck - Defensive" "84142" - #L "Ring of Luck - Offensive" "84143" - #L "Ring of Power - Elements" "84157" - #L "Ring of Suffering" "136617" - #L "Ring of Zern" "136601" - #L "Snake Ring" "136611" - #L "Toe Ring" "136657" - #L "Engagement Ring" "136603" - #L "Bracer of Reflection - Projectile" "84175" - #L "Bracer of Reflection - Physics" "84177" - #L "Bracer of Reflection - Nano" "84179" - #L "Bracer of Reflection - Melee" "84181" - #L "Bracer of Reflection - Energy" "84183" - #L "Bracer of Reflection - Elements" "84185" - #L "Ring of Power - Projectiles" "84147" - #L "Ring of Power - Physics" "84149" - #L "Ring of Power - Melee" "84153" - #L "Ring of Power - Energy" "84155"

- Known exceptions (will not melt to ingots): #L "Augmented OT Ring" "160424" - #L "Excellent IQ Ring" "84145" - #L "Failed Ring of Flying" "40828" - #L "Fashionable Energy Ring" "160739" - #L "Silver Pearl" "136653" - #L "Ring of Knowledge" "70255" - #L "Gold 2 Sphere Pearl by Peters & Tool" "25825" - #L "Ring of Presence" "160426" - #L "Ring of the Nucleus Basalis" "202718" - #L "Ring of Thorns" "136613" - #L "Bracer of Growing Flesh" "84187" - #L "Bracer of Shrinking Flesh" "84161" - #L "Bracelet of Pacifism" "84188"
Note: Melting down metal will take x3 for Silver, x3.4 for Gold and x3.8 for Platinum in Mechanical Engineering Skill based on the QL of the Ingot.
